Figure 2:The Wiring view during a run of the demonstration on Wactorz 0.8,
grouped by machine. Agents are on the left of each band and topics are
rounded boxes. The detector on the main machine publishesperson-detection, which feeds a lamp trigger on main and a counter
that has been migrated to therpi-kitchennode: the edge crosses
machines because the counter subscribes to a topic, not to an agent. The
trigger’s output topic is outlined in red because no agent reads it; a topic
only the dashboard reads is marked as such rather than as a problem.
